messages:
Asha: RCA posted for the brief 2026-03-22 anomaly affecting hosted API. Link: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2378|RCA: transient model eviction + autoscaler race>. Summary: ~7m impact window, small spike in 500s (~1.2% of traffic), p99 latency blip for requests hitting cold shards.

Asha: Main points + ask: owners please confirm timelines for instrumentation and config guardrails.

Asha: OWNER ACTIONS:
- Add preflight check to autoscaler decision path to avoid evicting hot KV shards (Tom) — target 2026-03-30.
- Add p99-by-shard metric + alert, and annotate dashboard (Priya) — target 2026-03-27.
- Postmortem replay including autoscale churn scenario (eng-sre / Jordan) — run & share artifacts by 2026-04-02.
- Draft customer-safe summary for status page (Nina) — ready by 2026-03-24.

Tom: taking autoscaler guardrail. I'll prototype a throttle on eviction rate and open a PR. Canary plan needed.

Priya: will surface shard p99 and a heatmap in the infra dashboard. Also propose a low-severity alert for sustained eviction rate > threshold.

Jordan: will coordinate replay with eng-sre, need expected traffic profile from Asha. Suggest we include a replay with induced scale-up/scale-down events.

Asha: Uploaded traffic sample and notes: <https://internal.redwood.com/replays/serve-20260322-sample|replay bundle>. Includes scale churn scenarios and guidance for success criteria.

ops-bot: Incident INC-34789 created and linked to RCA 2378. Assigned: Tom, Priya, Jordan, Asha.

Nina: I'll draft a short customer-safe blurb and share in #support for sign-off. Need any customer impact numbers?

Asha: No customer data exposed. Affected percentage ~1.2% of requests during window. Include that and mitigation steps.

Tom: PR: <https://git.redwood.com/infra/patches/1002|fix/autoscaler-eviction-guard>. Adding unit tests and a short e2e run.

Priya: Dashboard widgets ready in staging, linking screenshot: <https://mon.redwood.com/dashes/eviction-heatmap|staging heatmap>. Will promote to prod after alert threshold review.

Jordan: Scheduling replay: 04/01 09:00 PT. Will post results + perf traces here.

Asha: Weekly check-ins scheduled: starting 2026-03-25, recurring Tue/Wed, invite sent. We'll close loop when all items merged and canaries stabilized.

Nina: Draft for status page: "On 2026-03-22 a short-lived autoscaler interaction caused transient model shard evictions, briefly increasing latency and errors for a small subset of requests. No data exposure. We've deployed guardrails and additional monitoring; full verification is in progress." LMK if edits.

Tom: LGTM.

Priya: +1.

Jordan: replay results posted: p95/p99 returned to baseline when guardrail active; attaching perf traces. Early signal looks good.

Asha: Thanks team. Please update INC-34789 with final PR links and prod rollout notes. Will consolidate final closure in this thread and post an action-closure summary. :white_check_mark:

Nina: Will coordinate support communications.

Tom: noted, will follow up on canary metrics.

Priya: ping when promoted to prod dashboards.

Asha: Closing note — single-source thread for follow-ups. If blockers, escalate to oncall.
